A Lesotho-registered software company. We build web and phone systems for businesses, and our own platforms in Sesotho and English that keep working offline on low-cost phones. Each project below links to a case study with screenshots.

Work

TM Stone Solutions (PTY) LTD Paving manufacturer, MaseruCLIENT · PRIVATE PREVIEW

  • Website with a calculator that prices a paving job from the published price list and opens WhatsApp with the paver, area and price filled in.
  • Then the owner's back-office for a phone, in four phases: quotes and costing; jobs, production and crew dates; stock and supplier orders; invoices and payments. Works offline; two phones share the same records.
  • 13 automated test suites. Back-office built and tested, not yet in daily use.

Philalink Mobile mechanic booking platformCLIENT · DELIVERED

  • Customers book a mechanic to their door and see the total before they confirm.
  • A booking goes to the nearest free mechanic within 50 km; the customer follows them on a live map.
  • Separate areas for customers, mechanics and the office; email notifications; inspection checklists and quotes.
  • Delivered and running on the client's own domain. 32 automated tests.
